pairs.target: nánàn de lù cóng shài wǎngjià hòutou chuān guòqù . tǎ wéi qiánliǎngtiān kànjiàn yípiàn luàn shéng , yǐwéi zǒu dào nàlǐ biàn gāi huítóu , jīnrì gēn nài lěi yánbiān yí rào , cái jiàn jiǎoxià yǒu jǐkuài diàngāo de shítou , liánchéng zhǎizhǎi yìtiáo , bù cǎi jìn ní lǐ yě néng zǒu .
pairs.english: The south-bank path passed behind the net-drying frames. Tavi had thought the tangle of ropes a dead end; circling its edge with Nerai today, he found raised stones forming a narrow mud-free walkway.
pairs.hanzi: 南岸的路从晒网架后头穿过去。塔维前两天看见一片乱绳，以为走到那里便该回头，今日跟奈蕾沿边一绕，才见脚下有几块垫高的石头，连成窄窄一条，不踩进泥里也能走。

pairs.target: xǐwǎn de nǚhái zhèng jiāng juǎnqǐ de wǎng wǎng jiàshàng tuō , jiàn tāmen lái , xiān jiào tǎ wéi bié fú zuǒbiān de gān , shuō nàgēn zhǐshì chēng zhe děng bǔ , jiè yìdiǎn jìn jiù dé chóngxīn lì .
pairs.english: The bowl-washing girl was dragging a rolled net onto a frame. Seeing them, she warned Tavi not to lean on the left pole, merely propped up awaiting repair; any pressure would mean setting it up again.
pairs.hanzi: 洗碗的女孩正将卷起的网往架上拖，见他们来，先叫塔维别扶左边的杆，说那根只是撑着等补，借一点劲就得重新立。

pairs.target: tā jiāng shēnchū qù de shǒu shōuhuí , bāng tā tuōzhù wǎng juàn de dǐxià , liǎng rén tái dào héngmù shàng , cái kōng chūguò rén de dìfāng .
pairs.english: He withdrew his hand and helped support the roll underneath. They lifted it onto the crossbar, clearing a passage.
pairs.hanzi: 他将伸出去的手收回，帮她托住网卷的底下，两人抬到横木上，才空出过人的地方。

pairs.target: nǚhái shuō zìjǐ jiào ā líng , lǎotóu shì zǔfù , jīnrì ruò zài yǒurén wèn édàn , biàn jiào tā zìjǐ xiàchuán qù mǎi .
pairs.english: The girl said her name was A-Ling and the old man her grandfather. If anyone asked about goose eggs today, he'd have to get off and buy them himself.
pairs.hanzi: 女孩说自己叫阿绫，老头是祖父，今日若再有人问鹅蛋，便叫他自己下船去买。

pairs.target: nài lěi xiào , wèn zhè tiáo lù dī shuǐ shí cóng nǎlǐ chūqù . ā líng zhǐxiàng wěizǐ hòutou , shuō nàlǐ yǒu tiáo jiù dī , shuǐ dī le cái jiē dé shàng , jìnàn nà kuài duǎnbǎn yǐjīng shōu le , rújīn zǒu tāmen jiǎoxià zhè yílù , bié yánzhe qùnián tú shàng nàduàn qiǎntān héng guòqù .
pairs.english: Nerai smiled and asked the low-water exit. A-Ling pointed behind the reeds: an old dyke connected only at low water. The near-shore plank was withdrawn; now use this path, not cross the shallows on last year's map.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾笑，问这条路低水时从哪里出去。阿绫指向苇子后头，说那里有条旧堤，水低了才接得上，近岸那块短板已经收了，如今走他们脚下这一路，别沿着去年图上那段浅滩横过去。

pairs.target: tā běnlái yào sòng wǎng qù bǔ , méi dāying zhěngtiān dài rén zhuǎn . nài lěi ná xiǎo zhǐ jìxià tā yuànyì gàosù de dìfāng , shuōmíng zhī zǒu xiàn xià néng zǒu de àn lù , dī shuǐ nà yíduàn réng dé lìng chá , bú jiào tā tì hái méi jiàn guò de shuǐwèi zuòbǎo .
pairs.english: She had nets to take for repair, not a whole day's guiding. Nerai noted her directions and specified they would walk only currently usable shore paths; the low-water stretch needed another check, not her guarantee for unseen water levels.
pairs.hanzi: 她本来要送网去补，没答应整天带人转。奈蕾拿小纸记下她愿意告诉的地方，说明只走现下能走的岸路，低水那一段仍得另查，不叫她替还没见过的水位作保。

pairs.target: wǎngqián yíduàn , jiǎoxià de shítou tūrán kuān qǐlái . tǎ wéi yǐwéi dào le dīdǐng , dūnxià cái kànjiàn liǎngpáng dōu yǒu hòulái lěi guò de suìshí , zhōngjiān jiù shí yā zài gèng dī yìcéng , xiàng yǒu yìtiáo lù bèi xīnlù gàizhù , zhī shèng bèijǐ .
pairs.english: Farther on the stones widened. Tavi thought it a dyke crest, but crouching saw later rubble on either side, older stone lower in the middle, like an old road covered by a new one with only its spine showing.
pairs.hanzi: 往前一段，脚下的石头突然宽起来。塔维以为到了堤顶，蹲下才看见两旁都有后来垒过的碎石，中间旧石压在更低一层，像有一条路被新路盖住，只剩背脊。

pairs.target: jǐkē liǔshù cóng jiēfèng lǐcháng chū gēn , gēn biān gēzhe bǔguò de táogāng , lǐmiàn búshì shuǐ , shì yìjiārén zhǔnbèi xià zhǒng de dòuzǐ .
pairs.english: Willow roots grew through joints beside a patched pottery jar holding a family's seed beans rather than water.
pairs.hanzi: 几棵柳树从接缝里长出根，根边搁着补过的陶缸，里面不是水，是一家人准备下种的豆子。

pairs.target: nài lěi yán wàicè liáng chū jiǎoxià kěyǐ cǎi de kuān chù , ràng tǎ wéi xiān jì yǎnqián de gāodī , bù chāi rénjiā de táogāng qù zhǎo zhěngkuài shítou .
pairs.english: Nerai measured the walkable width along the outside and had Tavi record visible levels, not dismantle someone's jar to find an entire stone.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾沿外侧量出脚下可以踩的宽处，让塔维先记眼前的高低，不拆人家的陶缸去找整块石头。

pairs.target: tā ràokāi gāng , huà dào shùgēn shí , wénjiàn shī tǔ lǐ yìdiǎn liáng wèi , hūrán xiǎngqǐ huī ào lú fáng de dì zǒngshì gānrè de , zìjǐ cóngqián yǐwéi shífèng zhī huì cáng huī .
pairs.english: He drew around the jar and roots, smelling cool damp earth, remembering Ash Hollow's dry-hot furnace floors and how he'd once thought stone cracks held only ash.
pairs.hanzi: 他绕开缸，画到树根时，闻见湿土里一点凉味，忽然想起灰坳炉房的地总是干热的，自己从前以为石缝只会藏灰。

pairs.target: zài zǒu chūqù , shuǐmiàn chǎngkāi , yuǎnshān zài bówù lǐ diéchéng jǐdào dàn yǐng . zhèlǐ jìng yě kàndéjiàn shān , zhǐshì shān búzài xiàng ménkuàng , duānduānzhèngzhèng jiāng jiēdào jiázhù .
pairs.english: Farther out the water opened, distant mountains layered faintly in mist. Mountains were visible here too, but no longer framed the street like a neat doorway.
pairs.hanzi: 再走出去，水面敞开，远山在薄雾里叠成几道淡影。这里竟也看得见山，只是山不再像门框，端端正正将街道夹住。

pairs.target: shuǐ zài shānjiǎo ràoguòqù , wūzi tiēzhe shuǐ , wūhòu yòu yǒu yìtiáo bìng bù tōngwǎng gāochù de xiǎolù .
pairs.english: Water curved around their feet, houses beside it, another path behind the houses leading nowhere uphill.
pairs.hanzi: 水在山脚绕过去，屋子贴着水，屋后又有一条并不通往高处的小路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn le yíhuìer , nài lěi méiyǒu jiào tā kuàijì . tā zìjǐ yě wàng zhe nàbiān , jiāng màozi zhāixiàlái tòuqì , shuō qùnián láishí shānshàng yǒu yípiàn báihuā , jīnnián méi gǎnshàng , bù zhīdào shì huāqī zǎo le háishì wǎn le .
pairs.english: Tavi stood a while, Nerai not hurrying his notes. She looked too, removing her hat for air: last year white flowers covered the slope, but she'd missed them this year, not knowing whether the bloom was early or late.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站了一会儿，奈蕾没有叫他快记。她自己也望着那边，将帽子摘下来透气，说去年来时山上有一片白花，今年没赶上，不知道是花期早了还是晚了。

pairs.target: " nǐ yě huì xiǎng xiàhuí zài láikàn ? " tā wèn . " huì . búguò xiàhuí de huó wèibì zài zhèér . bùnéng měi huí dōu jiào huā děng zhe wǒ . "
pairs.english: “You want to come back and see them too?” he asked. “Yes. But my next job might be elsewhere. Can't always have flowers waiting for me.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你也会想下回再来看？”他问。
“会。不过下回的活未必在这儿。不能每回都叫花等着我。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào , jiāng nà jǐdào shānyǐng huà dào zhǐ jiǎo , zhī liú dé hěndàn , bù nálái gěi jiǎoxià de xiǎolù dìngwèi .
pairs.english: Tavi smiled and drew the mountain silhouettes faintly in a corner, not using them to locate the path underfoot.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑，将那几道山影画到纸角，只留得很淡，不拿来给脚下的小路定位。

pairs.target: fēng cóng wěicóng lǐ guòqù , shēngxiǎng yízhèn jiē yízhèn , yuǎnchù yǒurén jiào chuán , jiào le liǎngbiàn , cái yǒu lìng yídào shēngyīn yìng .
pairs.english: Wind rustled the reeds in waves. Someone called for a boat twice in the distance before another voice answered.
pairs.hanzi: 风从苇丛里过去，声响一阵接一阵，远处有人叫船，叫了两遍，才有另一道声音应。

pairs.target: lú shí cóng shuǐbiān jīngguò , chuánshàng yǐyǒu kè , méi tíngxiàlái . tā tái gāo zhǐxiàng qiántou yíduàn shí àn , shuō nàbiān jiē huí cháng zǒu de dàlù , zài wǎng wài jiù búshì jīnrì shuōhǎo de dìfāng le .
pairs.english: Lushi passed on the water with passengers and didn't stop. Raising her pole toward stone bank ahead, she said it joined the usual road; beyond wasn't in today's agreed area.
pairs.hanzi: 芦实从水边经过，船上已有客，没停下来。她抬篙指向前头一段石岸，说那边接回常走的大路，再往外就不是今日说好的地方了。

pairs.target: nài lěi cháo tā jǔshǒu , děng chuán guòqù , biàn tóngtǎ wéi zǒu dào tā zhǐ de nàge kǒu , liáng guò jiē lù de fāngxiàng , yuán lù zhéhuí .
pairs.english: Nerai waved and waited for the boat to pass, then walked with Tavi to the indicated junction, measured the connection's direction, and retraced their steps.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾朝她举手，等船过去，便同塔维走到她指的那个口，量过接路的方向，原路折回。

pairs.target: huíchéng tāmen yùjiàn ā líng . tā bèishàng de wǎng yǐjīng fàngxià , shǒulǐ duō le liǎngjié yòng shèng de xìshéng , shuō bùzhíqián , ruò huàtú de yào bǎng zhǐ biàn ná qù , bié yòu rènchéng shuíjiā de ménpái .
pairs.english: Returning, they met A-Ling, her net gone and two leftover pieces of fine cord in hand. Worth nothing, she said; use them to tie maps, just don't mistake them for someone's door marker again.
pairs.hanzi: 回程他们遇见阿绫。她背上的网已经放下，手里多了两截用剩的细绳，说不值钱，若画图的要绑纸便拿去，别又认成谁家的门牌。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , wèn tā shìfǒu měinián dōu huàn yíchù zhù . tā shuō yě búshì huàn le biàn quán bù huílái , zǔfù zǒng diànjì jiù zhuāng biān nà kē shù , zhù dào biéchù , háiyào jiào tā lái kànkàn shìbushì bèi rén kǎn le .
pairs.english: Tavi took them and asked if she moved every year. Moving didn't mean never returning, she said: her grandfather kept worrying about the tree by the old post and sent her back from elsewhere to check it hadn't been cut down.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，问她是否每年都换一处住。她说也不是换了便全不回来，祖父总惦记旧桩边那棵树，住到别处，还要叫她来看看是不是被人砍了。

pairs.target: ā líng shuō zhèhuà shí yǒuxiē búnàifán , jiǎobù què cháo shù nàbiān guǎi le .
pairs.english: A-Ling sounded impatient, yet her steps turned toward the tree.
pairs.hanzi: 阿绫说这话时有些不耐烦，脚步却朝树那边拐了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi méiyǒu gēn qù wèn yíchuàn jiùshì , zhī zài zhǐ shàngjiàng xīn chá guò de lù tóng zuórì nà chǔ fènkāi , biāochū rào shài wǎngjià de dìfāng , liúzú néng zhuǎnshēn de kòngxì .
pairs.english: Tavi didn't follow with a string of questions about the past. He distinguished the newly checked route from yesterday's, marking the bend around the drying frames with room to turn.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维没有跟去问一串旧事，只在纸上将新查过的路同昨日那处分开，标出绕晒网架的地方，留足能转身的空隙。

pairs.target: wǔhòu tā ná zhe cǎotú dúzì cóng kèdiàn zǒu dào chàkǒu , nài lěi zài hòumiàn gé le yíduàn , kàn tā shìfǒu hái huì zǒujìn tóng sè bù de xiǎoxiàng .
pairs.english: That afternoon he walked alone with his sketch from the inn to the fork, Nerai following at a distance to see if he'd still take the matching-cloth alley.
pairs.hanzi: 午后他拿着草图独自从客店走到岔口，奈蕾在后面隔了一段，看他是否还会走进同色布的小巷。

pairs.target: zhè yícì tā rènchū le lù , què méi jí zhe huítóu shìyì . qiánmiàn yǒurén dān zhe liǎngtǒng shuǐ , tā kàoqiáng děng nà rén guòqù , cái bǎ zhǐ jǔ qǐlái , ràng nài lěi kàn zìjǐ tíng zài shénme dìfāng .
pairs.english: He recognized the route this time but didn't turn to signal immediately. Someone carrying two water buckets approached; he waited by the wall, then raised his paper to show Nerai where he'd stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 这一次他认出了路，却没急着回头示意。前面有人担着两桶水，他靠墙等那人过去，才把纸举起来，让奈蕾看自己停在什么地方。
